reason: The cited evidence shows that a complex La-Ce-Zr-Al support improves stability and activity via oxygen mobility and metal incorporation, but it does not isolate ceria–zirconia alone, does not demonstrate abundant oxygen vacancies as the engineered feature, and does not provide data on reduced PGM loading or direct comparison to a γ-Al2O3 baseline for that claim.
premises: Ceria–zirconia supports can be engineered with abundant oxygen vacancies
Oxygen vacancies in ceria–zirconia enhance oxygen storage capacity and oxygen mobility
Oxygen vacancies promote strong metal-support interactions that stabilize Pd particles and minimize sintering
The Mars–van Krevelen mechanism is the dominant oxidation pathway on such supports
Replacing γ-Al2O3 with this support will reduce light-off temperature, improve durability, and allow lower PGM loading
